title: Hand-in-Face Shooting
description: A partner closes out and holds a hand up near the shooter's eyes on every shot, teaching shooters to keep their eyes on the rim and their arc high under a contest.

content.objective: Keep the same form and a higher arc when a hand is in the shooter's vision.
content.setup: Shooter at a spot; partner with a second ball as passer and contester.
instructions: The partner passes to the shooter and closes out under control.
The partner raises a hand near the shooter's eyes without touching.
The shooter keeps the eyes on the rim through the hand and shoots with extra arc.
coachingPoints: Look through the hand to the rim.
Higher arc, not a faster release.
Do not lean away: stay balanced.
commonMistakes: Fading backward to avoid the hand.
content.safety: Contester never touches the shooter or swipes at the ball; shooter lands in place.
progressions: Shooter must make two in a row before moving.
regressions: Contester holds the hand still at arm's length.
variations: Use a raised pad instead of a hand.
successCriteria: Makes at least half against the contest.
content.gameApplication: Most game shots are contested; shooters must keep their form when a hand is up.
